# API coverage

<!-- GENERATED by `webext-coverage registry --markdown`. Do not edit; edit Data/api-support.json instead. -->

How much of the Chrome and Firefox extension API surface is covered. Numbers count API members (functions, events and properties) that the browser has, and come straight from `Data/api-support.json`.

- **core**: provided by this crate and covered by tests (`implemented` + `partial`).
- **+host**: also counts `delegated` members, which the crate validates and routes but the embedding browser must implement.
- **planned**: not available yet; calling it fails with a clear error.

| Browser | Members | core | +host | planned |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Chrome | 399 | 14.3% | 34.3% | 262 |
| Firefox | 417 | 12.9% | 31.9% | 284 |
